analysis.purpose: A bounded DataWeave scanner that lifts the parts of a transformation that matter for code intelligence: header directives, declared functions and variables, call sites, and property or resource references.
responsibilities: Tokenize and structurally scan DataWeave without a full grammar
Record declared functions, variables and their call sites
Surface property KEYS and resource names as references

businessRules.rule: The scanner surfaces property keys and resource names but never their values.
businessRules.rationale: A secret value must never enter the graph, even indirectly.

nodes.name: DataWeave scanning
nodes.summary: Structure and references from DataWeave transforms.

edges.rationale: This file is the DataWeave scanner.
